todayEvents.title: San Francisco Coffee Festival 2026
todayEvents.note: The 10th annual San Francisco Coffee Festival features curated coffee tastings from top Bay Area roasters and exhibitors plus live music.

todayEvents.title: Inner Sunset Flea Market 2026 (Season Finale)
todayEvents.venue: Inner Sunset, 9th Avenue and Irving Street
todayEvents.note: The season finale of this monthly community flea market transforms Irving Street between 9th and 11th Avenues into a lively street market.

todayEvents.title: San Francisco's Annual Veterans Day Parade 2026
todayEvents.note: San Francisco's annual Veterans Day Parade honors the service and sacrifice of the Armed Forces along the northern waterfront at Fisherman's Wharf.

todayEvents.title: Blankets & Blockbusters: Toy Story 5 Outdoor Movie
todayEvents.note: This free outdoor screening of Toy Story 5 plays on the plaza board at Thrive City, with family-friendly movie-themed activities and the film starting at 1 PM.

todayEvents.title: San Francisco Symphony: Isabel Leonard Sings Ravel
todayEvents.note: Mezzo-soprano Isabel Leonard performs Ravel with the San Francisco Symphony at Davies Symphony Hall.

events.title: SF Tea Festival 2026
events.note: The two-day festival lets visitors taste hundreds of teas from more than 30 tea makers, with admission including unlimited tastings and a souvenir porcelain tasting cup.

events.title: SF VegFest 2026
events.note: Now in its 27th year, SF VegFest celebrates plant-based living with speakers, vegan chefs, and more than 80 exhibitors.

events.title: Renegade Craft Fair – Winter 2026
events.note: More than 250 curated artists and small businesses sell ceramics, jewelry, clothing, and home goods at this indoor holiday market, with free entry and a suggested $5 donation.

events.title: SF Civic Music Free Concert
events.note: The San Francisco Civic Music Association presents free public classical concerts performed by its community ensembles.

events.title: San Francisco International Hip Hop DanceFest
events.note: The 28th annual festival presents professional hip hop dance companies from around the world on the Palace of Fine Arts stage.

events.title: Renegade Craft Fair – Winter 2026
events.note: Sunday is the second day of the winter craft fair, with 250+ makers, indoor shopping rain or shine, and food trucks outside.

events.title: Waitress (Touring)
events.note: The touring production of the hit Broadway musical Waitress plays a Sunday matinee at the Orpheum Theatre on Market Street.
